desc:
One hunter. A world that wants you dead. Only one side makes it out. 

SURVIVORS: You're being hunted. Stick together, fight back, and stay alive long enough to make it out - because the moment you're alone, you're already gone.

HUNTER: You are the thing they run from. Tear through the map, hunt them down, and leave nothing standing. Show them why this world fears you.

Unleash legendary anime powers, destroy everything in your path, and decide how the hunt ends.

Will you be the hunter... or the hunted?
